VM Bridge provides local guest-console and existing SSH access for Windows + VMware Workstation through CLI and stdio MCP.

For installation, clone the tagged source (or extract the source archive), then run `pwsh -File Install.ps1`. Python wheels and source distributions are attached for developers; a wheel alone does not install the optional skill or launcher. See the repository's setup and AI-client guides.

This is beta software. Guest input prerequisites vary. No service, background updater, telemetry uploader or automatic VM power action is installed. Original code is MIT; bundled third-party components retain their notices and licenses.
